lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh the lock files once a month, for review. Renovate runs weekly, so the first seven days of a month hold exactly one run. Cargo.lock gets its own PR through the rust-dependencies group. A refresh has no release timestamp, so minimumReleaseAge would hold it forever

packageRules.description: Group and automerge non-major npm updates (devDependencies, pnpm overrides, packageManager)

Pin GitHub Actions digests; group and automerge non-major updates, digests included, once they are 3 days old: a retargeted tag is how the tj-actions/changed-files compromise spread. A digest update is aged by the release its tag resolves to but carries no timestamp of its own, which must not hold it forever

napi-rs toolchain: the CLI and the napi crates build and package every binary, so they update together and are reviewed, never automerged (#518, #526, #529). Keep this rule after the generic ones, as later rules win
Keep the napi-rs packages at exact versions in package.json, so a toolchain update shows in the reviewed diff and not only in pnpm-lock.yaml
Keep the typescript-5 alias on TypeScript 5: scripts/check-consumer-types.mjs type-checks the consumer projects with it as well as with the typescript devDependency
